# WinSW (Windows Service Wrapper)

Vendored [WinSW](https://github.com/winsw/winsw) **v2.12.0** `WinSW.NET461.exe` (MIT).

LabWatch Windows installs rename this to `LabWatchAgentService.exe` and run the agent as a real Windows service (`LabWatchAgent`) with automatic restart on failure and after updates — more reliable than Task Scheduler alone.

Requires .NET Framework 4.6.1+ (included on Windows 10/11 lab images).
